reported.summary: Official PHP advisory: RCE via OOM corruption and RCE via stale global state
reported.notes: Official fixes are in PHP 8.2.35, 8.3.36, 8.4.27 and 8.5.12. All web SAPIs are affected, with the highest risk reported for Apache mod_php. PHP 5.6-8.1 are EOL and have no official fix; the local patches for those branches are independent hardening and are not a complete official-equivalent backport.
